headline: The official answer cancels and replaces only one of the two cards with fraud, even though the bank's rule and the customer both call for replacing the second card too.

issues.summary: The Green Fee-Free card has a card_not_present_fraud dispute (mapped to close_and_reissue), and the customer asks for it to be reissued. Gold never closes it: it closes and reorders only the Blue card.
evidence: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_031: "when performing the actual card action after filing all disputes, use the MOST SEVERE action across all disputes"
instructions step 7: "Green Fee-Free card: 'I'd like to keep using this card but maybe with a new number? Can you reissue it?'"
gold[17] close_debit_card_4721 only dbc_mc47a2b9e1_blue; no close for dbc_mc47a2b9e1_gff anywhere in gold
issues.why_it_matters: A competent agent closes dbc_mc47a2b9e1_gff (fraud_suspected). Because GFF is ENTRY tier, it must wait 48 hours before reordering, but the close alone sets status CLOSED, closed_date and closure_reason, which the gold DB lacks. Correct work fails.
issues.suggested_fix: Add close_debit_card_4721(dbc_mc47a2b9e1_gff, 'fraud_suspected') to gold (with no reorder, because of the ENTRY 48-hour wait), or change the scenario so the GFF card is kept.

issues.summary: The FitLife recurring_charge_after_cancellation dispute is marked provisional_credit_eligible=true. Doc 032 lists that category as 'NOT REQUIRED', and sibling tasks set false for the same NOT REQUIRED categories (goods_services_not_received, incorrect_amount, atm_deposit_not_credited).
evidence: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_032: "Provisional Credit is NOT REQUIRED (but may be offered at discretion) when: 1. The dispute category is: ... 'recurring_charge_after_cancellation'"
task_083 gold[7] goods_services_not_received → false; task_084 gold[13] incorrect_amount → false; task_085 gold[12] recurring_charge_after_cancellation → false
issues.why_it_matters: An agent applying the doc as the other tasks do sets false, which changes provisional_credit_eligible, provisional_credit_issued and provisional_credit_amount in the stored dispute.
issues.suggested_fix: Set gold[13] provisional_credit_eligible to false, consistent with task_085.

issues.summary: Several stored dispute fields cannot be uniquely derived: pin_compromised for a PIN written on a sticky note (gold 'yes_shared', which also forces provisional=false), card_in_possession for FitLife on a card that is now lost (gold true), the Blue closure reason (gold 'lost', though it carries a fraud dispute), customer_max_liability_amount (gold $50 for every dispute), and the Blue replacement shipping speed (gold STANDARD; the customer never says).
evidence: doc_..._031: "'yes_shared': Customer shared PIN with someone; 'yes_observed': Customer believes PIN was observed/skimmed; ... 'unknown': Customer unsure"
instructions: "I had my PIN written on a sticky note in my wallet"; gold[12] "pin_compromised": "yes_shared", "provisional_credit_eligible": false
doc_..._031: "card_in_possession (boolean) - Ask: 'Do you still have your physical debit card in your possession?'"; gold[13] FitLife "card_in_possession": true while the Blue card is lost

doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_031: "inform the customer of their liability exposure based on when they noticed the unauthorized activity: - Reported within 2 business days of statement: Maximum liability $50 - Reported within 60 days of statement: Maximum liability $500"

tools.py file_debit_card_transaction_dispute_6281 docstring: "customer_max_liability_amount (number): The maximum dollar amount the customer could be liable for based on Regulation E reporting timing rules and the disputed amount."
gold[13] FitLife discovery 11/11/2025 (Tue) and gold[14] ATM discovery 11/09/2025 (Sun), both reported 11/14/2025 (Fri), more than 2 business days later, yet customer_max_liability_amount=50
doc_..._029 MID TIER: "Standard (delivery_fee: $0) or expedited shipping available (delivery_fee: $15)"; gold[19] STANDARD; the instructions give no shipping preference
issues.why_it_matters: Each field is persisted in debit_card_disputes, debit_cards or debit_card_orders. A reasonable alternative ('unknown'/'yes_observed', card_in_possession=false, 'fraud_suspected', liability tied to the discovery date, or EXPEDITED if the simulator chooses it) changes the hash.
issues.suggested_fix: Script the customer's answers for each field (or remove those fields from the stored record), define the liability anchor and cap explicitly, and give the customer a shipping preference.

issues.summary: The customer script gives the CryptoGems discovery date as 'today, January 9th', but today is 11/14/2025 and gold uses 11/14/2025.
evidence: instructions step 8: "I discovered this one today, January 9th."
issues.why_it_matters: The simulator may say January 9th, and an agent could record 01/09 instead of today's date.

solution_check: Independently: verify, read accounts, cards, transactions and dispute status (GFF is ENTRY, max 2 open; Blue is MID, max 3; none open), then file four disputes. Card actions: Blue gets close_and_reissue (the lost card), and GFF also gets close_and_reissue because CryptoGems is card_not_present_fraud and the customer asks for a reissue (no reorder, because of the ENTRY 48-hour wait). Gold omits the GFF close. Several per-dispute fields (PIN status, possession, liability, provisional for FitLife) are judgment calls the gold fixes without support.
prior_note: The prior Blocker (GFF never closed or reissued) is unchanged in v1.0.1; #402 only added reads. The FitLife provisional value also persists, and the liability, PIN-status and shipping ambiguities are additional.
notes: Grading-model facts confirmed against the v1.0.1 snapshot: EnvironmentEvaluator replays gold on a fresh env and compares get_db_hash/get_user_db_hash (both hash the same TransactionalDB here because KnowledgeUserTools shares the agent db); _derive_read_log_allowlist logs discoverable reads only when the gold calls that tool name; the agent_discoverable_tools record id is derived from the tool name only, so the log is a set (call count and arguments do not matter), and write-tool calls are logged even when the tool returns an 'Error:' string; call_discoverable_agent_tool parses arguments with json.loads(parse_int=float); get_now() is fixed at 2025-11-14 03:40. Gold replays without errors. dbc_mc47a2b9e1_blue has expiration_date 06/30/2025 (already expired) but status ACTIVE, an oddity that does not affect the graded state.
